title: blumea lacera var. blumei
intro: Blumea lacera var. blumei, commonly known as Japanese mugwort, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae) and is native to East Asia. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting digestion, relieving menstrual cramps, and treating fever. The therapeutic actions of Blumea lacera var. blumei include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic properties.
